title: Practice Patterns and Guideline Non-Adherence in Surgical Management of Appendiceal Carcinoid Tumors

key_findings: Surgical resection techniques varied among patients with appendiceal tumors.
Average surgery duration was 21.4 minutes with an average blood loss of 0.45 liters.
95% of patients were alive at the last follow-up after a mean period of 21.3 months.
methodology: A retrospective chart review was conducted on patients who underwent surgery for appendicectomy from January 1, 2004, to December 31, 2013, at two general hospitals in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
limitations: The study is limited to a single geographic location.
It relies on retrospective data, which may introduce bias.
Sample size may not be representative of all surgical practices.
future_work: Investigate the long-term outcomes of different surgical techniques.
Expand the study to include multiple centers for broader data.
Examine the impact of patient demographics on surgical outcomes.
